```yaml
name: Check spy versions

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.3'

      - name: Run spy version check
        run: bash ci/check-spy-versions.sh
```
